change_summary: The retraction notice is titled with the tracked paper's title, "Green roofs and urban cooling", and the retraction covers the whole article. The article was retracted because of image manipulation in the supplementary figures, and also because the temperature data could not be verified. The paper's headline finding is that green roofs lowered surface temperature by 4 C in three cities, and that finding rests on the temperature data that could not be verified, so it can't be relied on.
evaluation: The draft's reference list has no entry for "Green roofs and urban cooling" by Haddad and Berg (2018). The draft's text does not cite "Green roofs and urban cooling" or Haddad and Berg (2018) anywhere.
recommendation: The article has been retracted because of image manipulation in the supplementary figures, and also because the temperature data could not be verified. The draft's reference list has no entry for "Green roofs and urban cooling" by Haddad and Berg (2018), and the draft's text does not cite it anywhere. The retraction doesn't touch the draft, because the draft doesn't cite this paper. You don't need to do anything, and you can dismiss this alert. If you add work on green roofs later, don't use this paper as evidence.
